notYet.title: Not available yet
notYet.body: This page opens with work order {wo}. Meanwhile, the other tabs above work as usual.

forbidden.title: This account cannot open this page yet
forbidden.body: This account has not been given access to this part of Tours yet. Ask the shop owner or a manager for access.

error.title: This page could not be loaded
error.body: Something went wrong on our side; your shop data was not changed. Please try again.

common.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

products.title: Products
products.empty: No products yet. Press “+ Add” to create the first one.
products.emptyFiltered: No products match the search or filter.
products.noProduct: Pick a product on the left or create a new one.
products.capped: Showing the first {shown} of {matched} — search or filter to see the rest

create.title: Add product
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. racha-day-trip

editor.previewSoon: Not available yet — the customer booking page opens with W1.1
editor.archiveBody: Archived products are not deleted, do not appear on the booking page and can be restored. Products that were on sale or have departures or prices need a reason of at least 10 characters.
editor.archivedNote: This product is archived and read-only. Press “Restore” to edit it again.
editor.readOnly: Read-only — editing needs the “edit tour products” permission
editor.currencyLocked: Product currency: {c} (locked: already published or priced)

pax.title: Traveller types & ages
pax.note: Ages are not verified by the system; vouchers show the traveller type and “show proof at check-in”. Guides can collect differences at the POS.
pax.sourceCopied: Age ranges: same as the shop setting (copied when the product was created · adjustable here)
pax.sourceCustom: Age ranges: set on this product (differs from the shop setting)

seasons.title: Seasonal & per-departure prices
seasons.note: VAT included · order: departure › season › base
seasons.depNote: Set from the departures calendar (screen 11) or here
seasons.depPickHint: Departures listed in the table; others from the calendar (T1.2)
seasons.childHint: The child price follows the “default child price” setting automatically
seasons.depTruncated: Showing the next {n} of {total} departures with their own price — see the departures calendar (T1.2) for the rest

extras.title: Extras
extras.passNote: Collected-on-behalf money stays outside VAT when shown on its own line, charged at cost, paid in the customer’s name and any discount is passed on. Otherwise warnings W05/W06 appear; sales are not blocked.
extras.flagsHint: Flags follow the “defaults per extra kind” setting
extras.suppressed: The shop’s required extra «{unit}» is not charged on this product because it already has «{product}» of the same kind
extras.suppressedOptional: The shop’s required extra «{unit}» is not charged on this product because it already has «{product}» of the same kind (the product’s one is optional)

pickup.title: Pick-up
pickup.note: Exact pick-up time is sent at 18:00 the day before · zones are shared by all products
pickup.priceLocked: Surcharges are prices — needs the pricing permission
pickup.corrupt: Zone data is damaged — edit and save it before turning it on
pickup.windowMin: A pick-up zone needs a window of at least 1 minute
pickup.windowOverOffset: The window cannot be longer than the minutes before departure

content.title: Content Thai / English
content.draft: Draft missing translations (shop reviews before publishing)
content.draftSoon: Not available yet — no translation service
content.shownAuto: Generated from settings in both languages
content.langs: Languages on the booking page: Thai · English

brochure.title: What the tour prospectus should include
brochure.note: For the shop only · not required · does not block sales
brochure.disabled: Turned off in this product’s settings

items.OPERATOR_LICENSE: Shop name, address, tour licence number

applied.title: Settings used by this product
applied.note: “Set on product” = this product only · the rest comes from the shop › template

example.title: The customer will see
example.note: Priced by the real pricing engine for {date} ({season}) = screen 01
example.errorNoDeparture: No departure to use as an example yet — create one and the price example appears here
example.errorNoPax: This product has no adult/child types yet, so the example cannot be priced
example.errorPricing: The example could not be priced: {detail}
example.errorPricingGeneric: The example could not be priced — check this product’s prices and settings

reason.PRICE_MISSING: There is no price for this departure or traveller type yet — set a price before selling
reason.SETTINGS_INVALID: The unit settings are invalid (time zone) — check the unit settings first

settings.title: Trip bookings
settings.otherDomains: Shop, payments, agents, tickets and integrations live in their own settings pages
settings.subUnit: {name} · every value has a template default and can be changed
settings.chainLead: Value used = the lowest level that is set
settings.stepBookingSub: Recorded at booking, not changed later
settings.legendDiffers: = set by the shop (can be reset)
settings.legendAccountant: = tax points the system does not confirm

view.autoRefund: no choice within {n} days = automatic refund

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some details are missing or in the wrong format — check and try again
errors.VALIDATION: Some details are missing or in the wrong format — check and try again
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item was not found in this unit — it may have changed; reload the page
errors.FORBIDDEN: This account is not allowed to do this yet — ask the shop owner or a manager
errors.PERMISSION: This account is not allowed to do this yet — ask the shop owner or a manager
errors.BUSY: Someone else is changing this at the same time — try again
errors.NAME_TAKEN: An active zone already uses this name — pick another name or turn the old zone off
errors.ZONE_LIMIT: The limit of active zones is reached — turn an unused zone off first
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This link name is already used — choose another
errors.PUBLISH_INCOMPLETE: Not ready to sell — it needs a Thai name, an active option and a traveller type that uses a seat
errors.BAD_STATE: The product’s status has changed — reload and try again
errors.CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Please confirm and give a reason of at least 10 characters
errors.CURRENCY_LOCKED: The currency can no longer change: the product was published or already has prices
errors.AGE_RANGE: The age range is invalid — the minimum cannot exceed the maximum
errors.AGE_OVERLAP: The age range overlaps another traveller type — adjust it
errors.LAST_ACTIVE_OPTION: At least one option must stay on
errors.LAST_SEAT_PAX_TYPE: At least one seat-using traveller type must stay on
